requirements: Is there exactly one single painting of Grump Hollow woodland with a pond?
Are there exactly nine small crumpled paper muffin wrappers visible in the scene?
Do all nine wrappers appear as pleated cream and pale golden brown paper liners with cake crumbs and mud smears?
Is the first wrapper located in the middle of the big muddy clearing?
Do the wrappers form a loose trail running to the right along the path toward the pond shore?
Is the last wrapper positioned on the shore path a few steps in front of Boppy's small fishing bench?
Are none of the wrappers lying on the bench or in the water?
Does each wrapper lie flat on the ground with a soft painted contact shadow?
Are all wrappers kept exactly the same size and in their original positions without any moved, enlarged, added or removed?
Are there no people, animals or monsters visible anywhere in the painting?
